decisions.reason: The formwork profile system is a core consumable line with several models close to the established offer, so it likely stays even though recent website evidence is missing.
Automated concrete distributor flow control supports the firm's automation strategy and is likely embedded in its integrated plant offering.

This magnetic formwork component complements the range, though it could be consolidated as the firm did with the shuttering magnet block.
